notes: Share counts are the 'up to' amounts disclosed in the prospectus; affiliate sales remain subject to Rule 144 volume limitations after release.

Releases tied to earnings dates (2026-08-10, 2026-11-10, 2027-02-10, 2027-05-10, 2027-08-10) are estimates: the actual unlock is the second full trading day after the corresponding quarterly results are released.

The Additional Release Shares (455.8M) only unlock early if the closing price is at least 30% above the IPO price for 5 of the 10 trading days ending on the First Earnings Release Date. If the condition is not met, they unlock at the 180-day expiry on 2026-12-08 instead (raising that tranche from 328.4M to 797.6M).

The Extended Lock-up pool (~1.76B shares held by certain shareholders) does not release at the 180-day expiry, it unlocks in tranches until the release of results for the quarter ending June 30, 2027, per the lock-up agreements.
